summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title() returning True only when writing to a terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Line lengths were checked by eye against Black's 88 limit, not with Black. Nothing was run.
